# Excalidraw

The server shows a drawing through the picture that the Obsidian Excalidraw
plugin exports next to it (plugin setting *Auto-export SVG*). The pictures in
`drawings/` were produced by Excalidraw's own export, from the scene stored in
`Sketch.excalidraw.md`.

## Exported in both themes

Follows the browser's light or dark mode, and links to the drawing's page:
